title: ThermalSourceDiscriminatorOutput
description: Schema for the experimental advisory thermal source discriminator score in ThermalSentinel.

status.description: Evaluation status of the experimental discriminator.

model_version.description: Semantic version of the audited model artifact, e.g. lr-v5f3-standardized.

evaluation_level.description: Whether this score applies to an individual pixel detection or an aggregated event group.

task.description: The frozen binary classification task on which the model was trained.

predicted_class.description: Advisory binary class favoring, or null if NOT_ASSESSED.

wildfire_score.description: Model-estimated conditional probability of WILDFIRE_CONFIRMED within the binary task (null if NOT_ASSESSED).

flare_score.description: Model-estimated conditional probability of GAS_FLARE (1 - wildfire_score) within the binary task (null if NOT_ASSESSED).

interpretation.description: Human-readable advisory explanation strictly bounded to binary likelihood.

evidence_basis.description: List of input features utilized in this evaluation.

limitations.description: Explicit notices of model bounds and unsupported classes.
